reviews.text:
If you are traveling with your pet and need a New World screwworm certificate and health certificate, this is the place to go.

If you are traveling with your pet and require a screwworm certificate and health certificate, this is the place to go.
Terrible service and abusive staff! Beware, don't be fooled! They claim to examine your pet and then charge you for doing nothing!
Excellent clinic and excellent service.
I am so grateful for the care my baby received, the accurate diagnosis, and the wonderful and attentive doctors. Thank you for being with us during this difficult time.
They saved our dog's life, we loved their service, and their prices are fair. We will always be grateful to everyone 🙏❤️

Amazing place! The vet who saw me was so sweet and kind.
I took my cat, and since cats tend to get stressed very easily, I was worried she might have a bad experience, but the vet was incredibly gentle. She treated her with so much care and patience, without hurting her at all.
The service was quick and efficient, and the facilities were spotless and super clean.
Without a doubt, I found my ideal and trustworthy vet!
Excellent service, the best in the area. They are incredibly friendly to both the animals and the people. I highly recommend them.

We couldn't be more grateful for the care and, above all, the love with which you've always treated Valentino.

We came to you after Valen got into trouble and had to have surgery, and since then, every time we return, we feel he's in the best hands. You always know who he is, greet him warmly, shower him with compliments, and genuinely care for him. ❤️

Once, you had to drain his fluids, using equipment and time, and you treated him incredibly well, and you didn't charge us a thing. Today we went back for a follow-up appointment, and when I asked how much we owed you for that visit and for today's, you again told us nothing.

Beyond the money, these kinds of gestures speak volumes about the human qualities of the people who work here. For those of us who love our animals as part of our family, finding professionals who also care for them with such love is priceless.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts to each and every one of you for everything you've done for him. You have our trust, our affection, and our 100% recommendation. ❤️

And of course, Valentino sends each of you a big hug and lick. 🐶❤️

Thank you for taking such good care of Valen. It truly means so much to us.

This is the second time I've been to this hospital, and the care was excellent. Dr. Karla treated my kitten with such compassion. Her diagnosis was accurate, and my cat recovered well after her treatment. Thank you 🙏🏼

I don't want to make this post too long, but I don't think words can adequately thank the ACC24 hospital team for saving my dog ​​Greñas's life. Let me tell you a little bit about it… he arrived with gastric torsion, something like that; I don't remember the exact diagnosis (correct me if I'm wrong about the term). It was an illness that required emergency surgery and intensive care, where his life was at stake… Today marks one month since that ordeal, and my dog ​​Greñas is now back to his normal life after being discharged with follow-up care at home.

In short, trust them completely; they know exactly what they're doing.

Human and canine quality
Honesty
Patience
Attentiveness
Love for their work
Top-notch facilities
Fair prices

Love you all 🫶🏻 ACC24 Premium Veterinary Hospital sends its regards from Greñas 🦁🙌🏻

Here are the pictures 📸
Excellent service and attention to detail 100%

We rescued a dog over the weekend and took her to this vet, and they overcharged her. They performed unnecessary tests and vaccinations, which is not the proper protocol. They took money from the deposit to cover whatever expenses they wanted. I would never recommend this vet. 😡 …

I've had both good and bad experiences, depending on the staff. Some members of the team could improve their handling of nervous/anxious dogs.

Thank you very much to Dr. Cielo, however, I've decided to stop taking my dog ​​to this veterinary clinic.

I took my dog ​​in because I noticed she was in pain and panting. I was very worried, and they very kindly explained that she had eaten a bee and had the stinger in her tongue. They saved my dog ​​from choking because of the swelling in her throat. Even though I was very nervous, the doctors were always very kind to me. I will definitely go back for checkups for my other dogs. :)

Excellent service and attention.
The veterinarians were very attentive and empathetic.
Excellent service, they treat my dog ​​very well, they know everything perfectly and the quality-price ratio is excellent.

Honestly, the prices are totally fair for the service and attention they provide. They are very attentive, and in terms of pet health, they are very professional, explaining all the procedures performed on your pet. Highly recommended!
Excellent service! The staff were very nice and friendly! We went today because our dog had been hit by a car, and their service was 10 out of 10.
Absolutely the worst!!! Don't risk your children's lives with these people who have no idea what they're doing

I took my six-week-old puppy in February; it was an emergency on a Sunday. They treated us very well, the diagnosis they gave Maia was spot on, and she improved significantly that same day. The three veterinarians who saw her were very kind to her. Today she's four months old and a very healthy puppy. Thank you :)
24-hour service
Excellent attention and service.
Excellent option for pet care; the doctors were super friendly, very patient, and explained everything step by step.

Terrible service from the arrogant "doctors." They told us our cat needed a culture, charged us for it, and never gave us the results. The doctor who came later said they hadn't done it, even though they charged me for it. They contradicted themselves, charged exorbitant prices, and showed a lot of insecurity when discussing your pet's progress. Zero empathy. I will never return to that awful hospital.

I later received an automated email from the veterinary clinic that mistakenly included an internal memo labeling me a “problematic owner.” This, beyond being an administrative error, only confirms the level of disorganization and lack of professionalism I had already experienced during my dog's medical care.

My decision not to return to this clinic is not solely due to this incident, but primarily to the negligence in the medical care my dog ​​received. After this experience, I am certain I will never take any of my dogs to this clinic again, as they deserve responsible, professional, and dignified medical care, both for the patients and their families, with qualified veterinarians who strive to improve their processes and care, and prevent situations of negligence like the one we experienced from happening again.

Labeling owners as “problematic” instead of acknowledging and improving deficiencies in medical care only reflects a worrying lack of professionalism in a service that deals with lives. I'M LEAVING THIS FROM ANOTHER EMAIL BECAUSE I CAN'T POST ANOTHER REVIEW DUE TO THE PAST.
My dog ​​was there and they didn't help her at all. They sold me medication they knew I wasn't going to use. I will never take any of my children there again.
Excellent service, they gave my dog ​​a dental cleaning, everything went very well.

My dog ​​was given a misdiagnosis; they diagnosed a knee problem when it was actually his paw. They couldn't diagnose it properly because, seeing how he walked, they immediately assumed it was his knee, so the problem persisted until I went for a second opinion and they told me what the real problem was. They didn't take his temperature, they didn't examine his paw completely, and they didn't compare the reaction of his other paws to see if there was a difference.

Terrible vet! I took my pug there the other day after she was injured by another dog, and they told me she would heal. They only gave her pain medication. As the days passed, her eye started to swell, so I went to another vet, and unfortunately, I had to have it removed. :(

I took my 14-year-old dog to the vet on Friday, January 23rd, because she couldn't relieve herself. She was seen by a doctor who told us she needed to be hospitalized because she had a low temperature and gas in her stomach.

The next day I went to pick her up, and my dog ​​wasn't moving; she was crying in pain. I asked if she needed to stay another day, and a doctor, whose name I don't know (she was blonde and young), turned to the doctor who had seen her on Friday, and right in front of me, they started whispering to each other and saying they "didn't have any medication." Then, the blonde doctor came to me and said they wanted to discharge her to "see how she was doing" and if she would "eat."

Obviously, I didn't leave her there and took her immediately to another veterinarian. All the way there, my dog ​​didn't move and was crying in pain. When we arrived at the other veterinarian, she had a temperature of 34 degrees Celsius (93.6 degrees Fahrenheit), which shows that they never regulated her temperature or tried to manage her pain, and yet they discharged her.

At no point were we told about the true severity of her condition, nor was the possibility of euthanasia mentioned. Honestly, I don't know if the staff is untrained or if they lack the necessary medications, but it was a very sad and disappointing experience.

We went back later, and the doctor who had mentioned the lack of medication denied everything. A terrible experience. My advice is to find another veterinarian for your dogs. They are part of our family and deserve the best.

Having previously worked in a veterinary clinic and knowing the treatment that patients and their families should receive, it's clear to me how awful the handling and care were at this place.

The photo is from when they gave her back to me.
Very friendly, they answer all your questions. They keep a record of your pet, which allows for better care.
Excellent service. Dr. Liz was wonderful; she was very attentive and explained my dog's condition in detail. I highly recommend them.
Excellent service! They treat the dogs incredibly well, and the place is very clean. 10/10
Excellent service, the best in orthopedics. They explained everything very well, and showed great love and care for our furry friends.
I just want to congratulate the entire hospital team; they were very kind and attentive to my pet. They performed surgery and everything went perfectly! 👍 Thank you so much for all your care. …
Excellent 24-hour service

Excellent service. Dr. Cielo is outstanding.
Everyone is very kind and passionate about their patients.

Everyone was very kind. I took my cat for a nighttime appointment and they treated him very well. They were very careful, the medicine they prescribed helped him a lot and now he's better. I would definitely go back for an emergency, although it is a bit expensive.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Exceptional care, even during the most difficult hours

I want to express my sincere gratitude to the veterinary hospital team for the top-notch care they provided to that furry member of my family. From the very first moment, their commitment, empathy, and professionalism were evident.

In particular, I want to highlight the doctors on the night shift: they are truly wonderful. Their dedication, patience, and expertise made all the difference during a critical time. It's comforting to know that, even at night, there are expert hands and caring hearts looking after our companions.

Thank you for making animal health and well-being a priority, and for treating each patient as if they were your own. You are the best!

Excellent service and attention from Dr. Karla; she was incredibly patient, kind, and professional.
They accept card payments and provide invoices.
Dr. Cielo is a true pet lover. She is very kind and welcoming.
Excellent service, very professional.
The staff are all very friendly, they treat the animals very well and are very professional.
Don't go there, I took my dog, they did a test on him, and I never received the results and they charged me a lot, 800 pesos.
They had the medication my cat needed, even though it was very specific.

Excellent service and professional care.
I couldn't be more grateful for the service I received. My dog ​​is a senior and needed surgery to remove tumors and a dental cleaning. From the very first moment, the team demonstrated great professionalism and clear, consistent communication. The treatment was incredible, and I felt completely at ease knowing she was in expert hands. The surgery was a complete success, and my dog's recovery has been excellent. It's a trustworthy place with a very attentive and dedicated staff. I would definitely recommend this hospital for any type of veterinary care. Thank you for taking such good care of my dog!

Excellent service. I went in at night for a checkup for my hedgehog, and they treated my pet very carefully and thoroughly. After the exams, they cleaned his ears, trimmed his nails, and gave me a diagnosis and treatment plan. Professional service.

From the very first visit, the service has been exceptional. All the doctors are incredibly kind, professional, and dedicated. You can tell they love what they do, and every pet that walks through the door is treated with love, respect, and personalized attention.

My little ones not only received the best medical care, but also treatment that gives me complete confidence and peace of mind. They explain everything clearly, answer every question patiently, and are always willing to help. It's such a relief to know there's a team so committed to my little ones' well-being.
I recommend ACC24 without hesitation. If you're looking for a place where your furry companion is treated like family, this is the perfect spot.
Very well-equipped, excellent service
Excellent doctors, Dr. Cielo Mailob

The hospital is great for emergencies; they treated my pet very quickly for seizures. However, I do NOT recommend scheduling appointments with them for external tests. They don't provide complete information, and if they give you instructions, they don't match what the tests actually require. I had to beg them to schedule the appointment, send me the blood test results they took from my dog, give me the prices, and even tell me the location. I understand that there's only one person at reception and they might have many patients, but it really seems like the IMSS (Mexican Social Security Institute) for pets.
Top-notch service from the entire team, always very attentive
My cat was given an incorrect diagnosis; after seeking a second opinion, they quickly found the real problem using the same tests provided by ACC24.

Excellent service.

Thank you.

A very good place. They treated my dog ​​for ingesting a foreign object. They ran tests to properly assess the situation, and as soon as it was confirmed, they proceeded with the surgery. Everything went very well; my dog ​​was back to normal within a week, and the post-operative period was also very smooth. The staff is in constant communication—excellent work.

We brought "Kitty," our cat, to ACC24 on June 27th. Dr. Cielo diagnosed her, ran tests, and treated her as best she could. She needed surgery, but the risk was too high, and the outcome could cause more suffering, so, as parents, we decided it was time to let her go.

Sometimes, as parents of our beloved cats and dogs, we want to see the most positive results, but we must remember that we do it not only for ourselves, but because it's what's best for our precious angel.

Dr. Cielo and her team were with us until the very end; we were with Kitty when she reached the end. They understood our grief and allowed us to take our time, and Dr. Cielo, with all her compassion and confidence, also helped me through this pain. I will never forget the kindness, compassion, and empathy of ACC24.

I took my cat at 7 am suspecting he had an obstruction. They took x-rays and suspected he had fluid floating between his organs. After the x-ray, they pricked his belly and it turned out to be fat. Then they decided to give him a suppository so he could defecate, and they charged me separately for 24 hours of hospitalization. I told them my cat was very nervous and I brought him there because it said there was a cat area. They gave me visiting hours around 9 am and in the afternoon around 5 or 6 pm. I visited him two hours later and they had him in the dog area, extremely scared. He freezes when he's frightened, and I told them, but they still left him there. He even had a tiny bit of litter there, supposedly to help him defecate, but he never did. When I went back around 6 or 7 pm, they gave him to me to see if he would go at home, but I had already paid for the 24 hours of hospitalization, which he didn't get. The treatment he received while in the dog area had already been awful.

My cat is doing well now. That day he didn't defecate even after I took him home. I had to take him to two other vets before I found the right one. With an oral laxative (Laxatone) they gave him, he was able to go the same day I took him (it had been five days since he'd barely defecated). Besides that, after other checkups, I know my cat is suffering from chronic stress. He literally gets sick when he's stressed, and I won't forget that they kept him in the cages with the dogs.

I'm not saying there aren't good vets, but if you're going to take your cat, I hope it's not a nervous one because they'll probably put it with the dogs, which is what they did with mine even though I told them many times that he was extremely nervous. By the way, I also didn't see any of the people whose credentials or licenses are posted actually working, but I suppose they forgot to post the ones for the vets who were open during the hours I went.
If you're looking for a place where your pet will be treated with dignity, this is the place. They have the vocation, they don't stress your pet, and their prices are reasonable.
I took my dog ​​in for services covered by my insurance and the service was good. They only have a few minor issues; their communication is lacking.

Excellent service and very good doctors.
My cat was spayed 3 years ago and was still showing signs of going into heat. When we went to see them, they recommended tests, x-rays, and an ultrasound. Everything was spot on.
We proceeded with exploratory surgery where they found a complete ovary that the previous veterinarians had left behind, which was causing her stress and frequent heat cycles.
We are very grateful for the care and attention they give to each patient!
Good evening, could you please share a contact number with us at clientes.animalcarecentergdl@gmail.com so we can discuss how we can improve our service? Thank you.
Good service

If I could, I'd give it 10 stars. Dr. Liz saved my dog's leg, even though other vets would have recommended amputation, and we saw improvement in just one week. I'm so impressed with the care. She was constantly monitoring his condition and provided answers to problems I'd been dealing with for years regarding his bones.

I'm so happy I found this clinic and especially Dr. Liz 😊
A million thanks from me and Falkor!!
Highly recommended 👍

This vet has helped me with my dogs' health issues. I'm very satisfied with the way the doctors and the owner treat them, their punctuality, and how well they're treated. My dogs even felt at home, which is a sign that they're well cared for. I highly recommend it. 🤗🤗🤗 …
They answered my emergency question very kindly.
Excellent service
Excellent service.
Excellent service and they treat your little dogs with lots of love 🫂❤️ …

Excellent service. They've taken care of my whole pack (4 cats and a dog) and have always been attentive and wonderful. When they've stayed at their boarding facility for various reasons, they've always kept me updated on how they're doing. They have separate areas for dogs and cats to minimize stress. They're very understanding of the animals' situations and treat them with so much love. My dog ​​LOVES going and I never see her afraid of anything ♡♡
I'm not going back, they hurt my dog, they gave her a bad diagnosis, I don't recommend it.
I arrived with my dog ​​around 9 pm and the service was very good and fast. It's amazing that they're open 24/7.
Very friendly and attentive, they treat your pet with great care. Excellent service in all aspects and affordable prices.

Wow, the care was amazing! Everyone who treated us here was so kind and knowledgeable! I took my dog ​​in for a diagnosis, and they immediately took an X-ray because of her symptoms (pyometra). They gave an accurate and incredibly fast diagnosis, did blood tests, and she went straight into surgery since it was an emergency. The anesthesia was inhaled (because of my dog's age), and she didn't have any complications. When I called to check on her or went for a visit, all the doctors knew about the case, which I think is incredibly important because they work in shifts. All the test results, X-rays, ultrasounds, etc., were sent by email for any future reference! I especially want to recommend Dr. Karlita, who gave Pimientita incredible care and affection! I 100% recommend everything (I've attached photos as proof). The price/service ratio is excellent!

Thank you!!!

I took my kitten to the emergency vet in the middle of the night. I had no idea what was wrong with her, and we'd gotten bad diagnoses elsewhere. However, at this hospital, they treated her incredibly well. They took x-rays to get a timely diagnosis. Highly recommended! The prices aren't outrageous, and it's a great value for the money. Now my kitten is super happy and healthy.

A very pleasant experience. The veterinarians were highly professional and skilled, and their diagnoses were accurate. Dr. Karla Huerta, in particular, saved my dog ​​from pancreatitis. I am incredibly grateful to the entire team and will never be able to thank them enough for saving my dog, Lards.

We had taken my puppy to another vet for an emergency where they gave him a bad diagnosis. They told us he didn't have a fracture when it seemed he did, so we decided to have him operated on here and they treated him wonderfully. The operation went perfectly and my puppy is already recovering. Thank you so much!

Terrible grooming service. I asked for a round haircut for my Pomeranian. Obviously, any vet or groomer knows that you don't use clippers on a Pomeranian's fur, only scissors. When they returned my dog, the haircut was terrible and his gums were injured. They claimed they never touched his teeth. I've attached pictures of how badly he looked after the haircut.

Excellent care and dedication during difficult times.

I want to share our incredible experience at this veterinary clinic that saved our dog Bailey's life.

When we found out she had contracted parvovirus, we were completely desperate, but the team at this clinic took care of everything with a professionalism and empathy we never expected.

From the very first moment, they provided us with all the necessary information, explaining the treatment and giving us hope. The care was quick and meticulous, and most importantly, it was clear they truly cared about our dog's health. Throughout the entire process, they kept us informed with daily updates, which gave us great peace of mind.

Thanks to their hard work and dedication, our dog overcame the illness and is now fully recovered. We can't thank them enough for giving our companion a second chance. Without a doubt, this clinic is a trustworthy place where the love for animals is reflected in every action. Highly recommended!
Excellent service! I took my puppy there and Dr. Cielo gave me the best care. 100% recommended.

Terrible service, overcharges, misdiagnosis, rip-offs—you'll find all that and more here.

I took my kitten in for a health problem. They took x-rays, charged me for a blood test, a consultation (the most expensive of my life), and so on.

They told me my cat had an incurable disease, that the treatment was extremely expensive, and that each bottle of medicine cost $15,000 pesos. They also said I had to pay $3,000 for a test to confirm it. The next day, it wasn't $3,000, it was $4,000—it went up overnight? 😒

Finally, I went to pick up my cat and took him to a more reputable vet, where they treated him well, did ultrasounds and several other tests, and completely ruled out the diagnosis ACC had given me.

I had purchased the treatment that was recommended to me (the one that cost $15,000 per bottle), but strangely enough, it only cost me $1,700 per bottle.

I have requested the results of the tests performed on my pet three times and have received no response. Could it be that they didn't do the tests and just charged me for them?

In short:

- They don't display the prices; they charge whatever they want.

- There is no transparency; I will never know if they actually performed the tests on my kitten.

- Their prices are extremely inflated.

I highly recommend staying away from this veterinary clinic. If I could, I would give it zero stars.

My dog's gastroenterologist referred him to them to stabilize his extremely high glucose levels.
Since we arrived late, the vets on duty received him and began treating him.
He was hospitalized for two days; they would take him out for short walks and then return him to his kennel.
They discharged him with his glucose levels stabilized and eating well.
The follow-up care has been very thorough.
The place is very clean, and they are careful and organized.
The vets who treated him were very kind, especially Karla, who has earned my dog's trust.

We all wish our pets would be treated with the same love we give them, and that's exactly what you'll find here.
All the doctors are incredibly kind and caring. I have nothing but praise and gratitude for all of them, especially Dr. Karly. She's simply a wonderful doctor, supporting us every step of the way with so much love and respect, from the best times to the most difficult.
It's the best place you could take your pet 🩷

I only bought medicine for my dog, but the guys there were very friendly, even though it was 9 pm (it was already closed, but I rang the bell and the guy came out). I was able to pay by card and it was even cheaper than at another vet where I used to buy it.

This is when you should read about this place before taking your pets.
It's clear there are quite a few bad reviews here, and now I see why.
It doesn't surprise me that I took my pet in for deworming and he came back with a pretty serious infection. I mean, the vets don't even wear gloves. It doesn't surprise me at all. Terrible hygiene. On top of that, I took my pet in for a checkup and they charged me for a diagnosis they didn't even do properly, since he continued to have discomfort, and according to the "doctor" on that night shift, he was fine.

Anyway. If you love your pets, don't hesitate to take them somewhere else. The fact that it's always empty must be a sign.

Excellent treatment of both people and animals. They gave my pet a very accurate and quick diagnosis and treatment. Dr. Cielo is a wonderful human being and an excellent veterinarian, as is all the staff.

I was very satisfied and will definitely continue to visit. My pets will be their patients from now on.

I went to ask about boarding prices for a stray dog. They quoted me an exorbitant price for the consultation plus the nightly boarding fee. When I asked if they could offer a discount because of the dog's situation, since I couldn't bring her home due to other dogs that don't live there, Dr. Cielo rudely replied that it was easy to be charitable with other people's money. She went inside and left an employee who, seeing the urgency and that we still had the money in hand, raised the boarding price by $200!
It's worth mentioning that a week earlier at Petco (because it's the same doctor), I was waiting behind another woman for a consultation. The doctor came out of her office and a client arrived, whom she greeted and went in before us, even though we had arrived earlier. Furthermore, when I asked for a calming medication for dogs, she suggested one with monosodium glutamate, which is toxic. Very disappointed with their care and lack of love for animals, I ended up at Valles, which is a much better clinic. The treatment of animals is very compassionate and loving, and despite being more prestigious, they always provide financial support!
They don't offer 24-hour service. I needed service in the early morning and they were closed, and they didn't even answer the phone.
Very kind
Excellent service, reasonable and affordable prices, and Dr. Cielo is a sweetheart!
Excellent 🐕‍🦺 service, highly hospital and daycare. …
Very ethical and professional, love animals! Excellent care for your pet and for you as their owner
Amazing service!!!! They attended to me super fast, my beauty is already recovering thanks to Dr. Ely and her team, in less than 24 hours we're almost back to 100% 💯 #orbita sends greetings …
Excellent care from the doctor and staff who treated us. They were wonderful to my kitten. Very kind 🖤 …
Hi, I've been calling you more than 10 times and you don't answer, you just pick up the phone and hang up again :(
Hello, I'm calling to see if you'll take my dog, and you keep hanging up on me... I've called 10 times and you don't answer, you just let the phone ring.
They know their stuff and are very patient. Their prices are fair and they provide excellent service; in any emergency, this is the place I would recommend.
Excellent service, very accurate diagnoses, and what I liked most is the way they treat the dogs. My dog ​​is seen by Dr. Karla and she's 100/10... I'm delighted with her!

Our kitten was hospitalized for post-operative care, and the care was excellent. Everyone was incredibly attentive, and every time I called or visited, I received a complete report. They also treated the animals with warmth and affection. I found the prices reasonable. I truly admire people who dedicate themselves to veterinary medicine with such professionalism and compassion.

Cielo is an excellent vet.

Highly recommended.
Excellent service, the doctors are super nice and caring with the furry ones.

Excellent service and care for the animals.
They helped me with the complete protocol for two rescued dogs, and both were very happy with the veterinarians.
Special thanks to Dr. Karla, who supervised their progress at all times.
Excellent 24-hour service; my dog ​​has been receiving care there. For the quality of service and facilities, the cost seems low on average.
Inexperienced staff, many apprentices for the high cost.

Excellent service! Highly recommended; they offer all services, including electronic records. A special thank you to veterinarian Karla, who treated my puppy with the utmost care, and he didn't suffer at all from the vaccination. 100% recommended!
Excellent service from everyone. They're also open in the evenings.

A terrible experience. They were only interested in the money. My dog ​​arrived sick, and they never gave us a precise diagnosis or prognosis. She was hospitalized for five days, with each day postponing tests to prolong her stay. …
